derived.prompt: Windows 11 was released after Windows 10, and Windows 10 was released after Windows 8. Does it follow that Windows 11 was released after Windows 8?
bridge: Windows 11 was released after Windows 10, and Windows 10 was released after Windows 8.
chain: Windows 11 was released after Windows 10, and Windows 10 was released after Windows 8. (given in prompt)
Without transitivity the two facts do not license the conclusion: no.
